text: Viewers don't only watch. You can suggest prompts, share links and files, and add to a braindump for the agent. The host decides what reaches it.
To suggest a prompt, open the Prompts tab next to the timeline, write it, and select Suggest to the host.
It goes to the host, not to the agent. Only the host and you see it, and nothing reaches the agent until the host sends it.
Under Your suggestions, you see what became of each one: waiting, kept for later, sent, edited and sent, or declined.
The host finds them in their own Prompts tab, oldest first, with who suggested each.
Send types it into the agent's prompt, as if the host typed it. Edit changes it first, Keep for later puts it aside, and Decline sends nothing.
To share a link, such as a preview deploy, select Send a link. The host sees it first.
The host shares it with everyone, or declines it. Each person opens it in their own browser.
When the host allows it, open Files, Shared, and Add files or a note. Choose where it goes: to the braindump for the agent, or shared with everyone.
The braindump collects notes and files from everyone. What is shared with everyone is for people to look at, and never reaches the agent.
When the braindump is complete, the host selects Give, edits the prompt if they like, and gives it all to the agent at once.
Whatever you send, the host reads it first and decides what reaches the agent.
